name: First Fruits The
overview: The concept of First Fruits in Scripture, as outlined in Leviticus 23:10-14, involves bringing the initial sheaf of the harvest to the priest, who then waves it before the Lord as an offering. This act includes presenting a lamb without blemish and accompanying offerings of fine flour mingled with oil and wine, symbolizing the dedication of the first and best produce to God. The Israelites were commanded not to eat any bread or grain until this offering was made, establishing a lasting statute that honors God by consecrating the beginning of the harvest season.
